descriptor: Stationery brand for sketchers and note-takers

voice.summary: Sounds like a friendly scribble in a sketchbook margin: warm, loose and a bit self-deprecating. It talks about pencils, erasers and patience with a smile.
dos: Use stationery words like stroke, sketch and rub out
Keep sentences short and a bit chatty
Let a joke about erasing slip in

taglines: Every line is a good start
boilerplate: Graphite & Gum is a stationery brand making pencils, sketchbooks and erasers for people who think best with a line on paper.

microcopy.success: All drawn. Ready when you are.
microcopy.error: The pencil slipped. Replay to try again.
microcopy.empty: Nothing sketched yet. Pick a shape.

logo.note: A hand-drawn G stands for the brand and looks like a quick pencil mark.
